name: roi-hero
description: ROI calculator page hero (Figma 'Pricing - New Jun 11 2026 - Opt 1', node 7169:88796, restyled per QA 2026-10-29): eyebrow, headline and lede on the white page beside a card holding the HubSpot quote form, drawn like the Get a Demo booking form (demo-booking's .ap-dw-* card, white floating-label fields, the indigo-to-green button, an optional compliance badge row) with no testimonial column. The form is the live A/B-tested /new-pricing/ quote form: behaviour.js loads HubSpot's v2 embed into the labelled mount, fills HubSpot's own labels from form_placeholders (they float on focus / value / autofill), applies the submit label and the redirect, and keeps ZoomInfo 'enrich' fields hidden until enrichment cannot fill them (same rules as pricing-hero). Reserves the form's height while it loads (no layout shift) and shows a contact line if HubSpot is blocked. Pairs with pricing-calculator variant 2026 (the gradient splash and glass card).

eyebrow.description: Small purple label above the headline, e.g. Asset Tracking ROI Calculator.

title.description: The big headline. Line breaks are kept.

body.description: Paragraph under the headline. Line breaks are kept.

h1.description: Which line is the page's h1. title: the headline is the h1 (eyebrow is a p). eyebrow: the eyebrow is the h1 and the headline an h2 — same look, keeps a search phrase such as 'ROI Calculator' in the h1 (as the homepage does).

form_label.description: Accessible name of the form, e.g. Get a Custom Quote.

hubspot_portal.description: HubSpot portal ID (digits). The form card renders only with a portal and a form ID.

hubspot_region.description: HubSpot region, e.g. na1 or na2. Picks the embed script host as well.

form_placeholders.description: Field text per HubSpot field name (lower-case), set once the form is drawn, e.g. {"email":"Work Email*","phone_entered_by_prospect":"Phone*"}. It becomes the field's floating label (HubSpot's own label, empty on this form) and its accessible name; the input's placeholder gets the same text but is drawn transparent.

form_submit.description: Submit button text, set once the form is drawn. Empty keeps HubSpot's.

form_redirect.description: Page to open after a successful submission. Empty keeps HubSpot's own thank-you behaviour.

form_enrich_fields.description: Field names (lower-case) held back until the visitor needs them: shown when ZoomInfo enrichment (data-zi-*-enriched) reports it could not fill them, and on submit unless enrichment filled them. Leave a field out of the list to show it from the start (Figma shows email and phone).

compliance_label.description: Small label above the compliance badges by the button (demo-booking's compliance_label). Shown only with compliance badges.

compliance.description: Compliance badges, the row the Get a Demo form shows (same shape as demo-booking's compliance). Beside the button when the card has room and the row is compact (every badge with w and h, at most 56px shown, the row at most 240px wide), otherwise under it. Each: image, alt, w, h (intrinsic size), display_h (shown height in px; defaults to h). Empty renders no row.

fallback_email.description: Email offered when the HubSpot form cannot load (blocked or offline), e.g. info@assetpanda.com.

fallback_phone.description: Phone number offered in the same line, e.g. (888) 928-6112. Hidden for international visitors (html.ap-intl).
